# WPMozo: WordPress Themes and Plugins

> WPMozo’s WordPress plugins for Elementor, WooCommerce, Divi, and Block Editor make building stunning websites and stores easy with customizable features\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v27.9, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Pages
- [Home](https://wpmozo.com/): WPMozo’s WordPress plugins for Elementor, WooCommerce, Divi, and Block Editor make building stunning websites and stores easy with customizable features\.
- [Elementor Fancy Heading Widget](https://wpmozo.com/addons-for-elementor/elementor-fancy-heading-widget/): The WPMozo Fancy Heading widget for Elementor lets you build three\-part headings on Elementor pages with pre\-heading text, main heading text, and post\-heading text styled independently\. Choose between inline and stacked layouts, apply background images or gradients behind the heading, and control typography for each part separately\. The widget works inside the Elementor builder panel and is available in the WPMozo Addons for Elementor plugin\.
- [Elementor Instagram Feed Widget](https://wpmozo.com/addons-for-elementor/elementor-instagram-feed-widget/): The WPMozo Instagram Feed widget for Elementor pulls posts from an Instagram account and displays them on a WordPress page using the official Instagram API\. Configure layout, columns, post count, caption display, and a custom follow button without writing any code\. The widget syncs new Instagram posts automatically so the website always shows current social content\. Available with the WPMozo Addons for Elementor plugin\.
- [WPMozo Addons for Elementor](https://wpmozo.com/product/wpmozo-addons-for-elementor/)
- [WPMozo Blocks and Addons](https://wpmozo.com/product/wpmozo-blocks-and-addons/)

## Products
- [WPMozo Blocks and Addons](https://wpmozo.com/product/wpmozo-blocks-and-addons/): \<p\>WPMozo Blocks and Addons for Block Editor is a plugin that adds 76 Gutenberg blocks for WordPress: 54 free, 22 Pro to the WordPress Block Editor library\.\</p\>
- [WPMozo Addons for Elementor](https://wpmozo.com/product/wpmozo-addons-for-elementor/): \<p\>The WPMozo Addons for Elementor plugin gives you a variety of Elementor addons and widgets, allowing you to easily and swiftly create stunning WordPress websites with flexible design options\.\</p\>
- [WPMozo Wishlist for WooCommerce](https://wpmozo.com/product/wpmozo-wishlist-for-woocommerce/): \<p\>A WooCommerce wishlist plugin with guest support, custom button positions, and design control without code\. Pro adds multiple named wishlists per customer, bulk actions, and admin insights into top\-wishlisted products\.\</p\>
- [WPMozo Gallery for Elementor](https://wpmozo.com/product/wpmozo-gallery-for-elementor/): Four specialized gallery widgets for Elementor: Masonry Gallery with up to 10 columns, Product Gallery for WooCommerce, animated Wavy Gallery, and Scrolling Zoom Gallery\. Build rich image galleries without writing CSS\.
- [WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce](https://wpmozo.com/product/wpmozo-product-grid-for-woocommerce/): WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce is a free WooCommerce product grid plugin that lets you display and customize your product listings in a column\-row grid layout using the Block Editor\.
